clips.title: The story
paras: In Windshear Crag, the Venture Company’s shredders wound Stonetalon’s spirits. Seereth Stonebreak hears their cries as XT:4 and XT:9 tear through the forest.

Orc shaman Seereth Stonebreak is stationed along the dusty border between the Barrens and the Stonetalon Mountains. She listens to the unseen realm, though chaos drowns out much of Stonetalon’s spiritual voice. One vision came through with harrowing clarity: man-shaped contraptions tearing through ancient woods with unnatural haste. Marked XT:4 and XT:9, the goblin-engineered shredders butcher Windshear Crag’s timberlands and send waves of distress through the surrounding nature spirits.

The Venture Company operates in Windshear Crag, northwest of Greatwood Vale. To stem the devastation, Horde champions venture there and track down the logging constructs. Wrecking XT:4 and XT:9 deals a sharp blow to the mountains’ commercial deforestation and calms the immediate cries of wounded tree spirits. Seereth warns that unless the Venture Company abandons Stonetalon entirely, far darker atrocities await the land.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is a relation to the spiritual magic of shamans and the natural magic of druids. This is why we shamans can hear the plea of the spirits of Stonetalon. Many of their whisperings are lost to me, but one message, one vision, is clear...
I saw a vision of two man-shaped machines in Windshear Crag, northwest of Greatwood Vale, felling trees with impossible speed. These metal beasts must be stopped!

clips.title: Progress
paras: The tree spirits wail at the loss of their brethren, friend. You must destroy the shredders XT:4 and XT:9, or I fear Stonetalon will never be healed.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The destruction of the machines XT:4 and XT:9 have soothed many of the spirits of Stonetalon, friend. With their loss, let us hope the Venture Company will remove itself from these mountains.
For if they do not, then I fear the atrocities this place has suffered will pale to what lies ahead.
